description: This Java class 'HttpResponseSerializer' handles serialization and deserialization of HttpResponse objects to and from JSON, including validation, logging, and support for arrays.

classes.name: HttpResponseSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class for HttpResponse objects, providing methods to serialize to JSON and deserialize from JSON, with validation and logging.
